description: This file defines classes and extension methods related to handling launch arguments, specifically for processing snapshot protocol activation in a Windows application. It includes logic for deserializing a snapshot from a URI segment, with error handling and logging.

classes.name: SnapshotLaunchArguments
classes.description: Holds information about whether an error occurred during snapshot processing and contains the snapshot data.

classes.name: LaunchExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for IActivatedEventArgs to handle snapshot protocol activation and argument extraction.

methods.name: TryGetSnapshotProtocol
methods.description: Attempts to extract and validate the snapshot protocol from activation arguments, returning true if successful.

methods.name: GetSnapshotLaunchArgs
methods.description: Deserializes a snapshot from the URI segments in the activation arguments, with error handling and logging.
